details: The brush listener registers for both 'brush' and 'end' events and calls render() on every mousemove without RAF or dirty-flag coalescing, triggering full redraws of both the main and hit canvases plus a DOM innerHTML update at 60fps; no transitions are used so there is no mid-flight race, pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly, and closures capture mutable outer-scope bindings (dims, xScale, yScales) that are always current.
